$comment: AG-UI conformance rule catalog. Data, not code: a Python/Go implementation shares these rules. Severities follow the working agreement that behaviour the spec does not clearly govern is at most 'info' — entries with 'specQuestion' were downgraded accordingly; see docs/spec-questions.md.

rules.title: Run does not start with RUN_STARTED
rules.messageTemplate: First event of the run is {type}; expected RUN_STARTED
rules.specQuote: The RunStarted event is the first event emitted when an agent begins processing a request.

rules.title: Multiple RUN_STARTED in one run
rules.messageTemplate: Duplicate RUN_STARTED (runId '{runId}') before the active run terminated
rules.specQuote: The RunStarted and either RunFinished or RunError events are mandatory, forming the boundaries of an agent run.

rules.title: Run not terminated
rules.messageTemplate: Run '{runId}' ended without RUN_FINISHED or RUN_ERROR
rules.specQuote: Every run terminates with either RunFinished or RunError.

rules.title: Event after terminal event
rules.messageTemplate: {type} follows the run's terminal {terminalType}
rules.specQuote: The RunStarted and either RunFinished or RunError events are mandatory, forming the boundaries of an agent run.

rules.title: RUN_FINISHED and RUN_ERROR are mutually exclusive
rules.messageTemplate: {type} emitted after the run already terminated with {terminalType}
rules.specQuote: Every run terminates with either RunFinished or RunError.

rules.title: STEP_FINISHED without matching STEP_STARTED
rules.messageTemplate: STEP_FINISHED '{stepName}' has no open STEP_STARTED
rules.specQuote: The stepName must match the corresponding StepStarted event.

rules.title: Step unterminated at run end
rules.messageTemplate: STEP_STARTED '{stepName}' never finished
rules.specQuote: The stepName must match the corresponding StepStarted event.

rules.title: Unstable threadId/runId across the run
rules.messageTemplate: RUN_FINISHED {field} '{actual}' does not match RUN_STARTED {field} '{expected}'
rules.specQuote: It also provides crucial identifiers that can be used to associate subsequent events with this specific run.

rules.title: TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT without start
rules.messageTemplate: TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT for messageId '{messageId}' with no open TEXT_MESSAGE_START
rules.specQuote: A message begins with a TextMessageStart event, followed by one or more TextMessageContent events that deliver chunks of text as they become available, and concludes with a TextMessageEnd event.

rules.title: TEXT_MESSAGE_END without start
rules.messageTemplate: TEXT_MESSAGE_END for messageId '{messageId}' with no open TEXT_MESSAGE_START
rules.specQuote: messageId: Matches the ID from TextMessageStart

rules.title: Text message unterminated at run end
rules.messageTemplate: TEXT_MESSAGE_START messageId '{messageId}' never ended
rules.specQuote: A message begins with a TextMessageStart event, followed by one or more TextMessageContent events that deliver chunks of text as they become available, and concludes with a TextMessageEnd event.

rules.title: Duplicate messageId within a run
rules.messageTemplate: messageId '{messageId}' was already used by a completed message
rules.specQuote: It establishes a unique messageId that will be referenced by subsequent content chunks and the end event.

rules.title: Empty content delta
rules.messageTemplate: TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT for messageId '{messageId}' has an empty delta
rules.specQuote: delta: Text content chunk (non-empty)

rules.title: Interleaved message streams sharing a messageId
rules.messageTemplate: TEXT_MESSAGE_START for messageId '{messageId}', which is already open
rules.specQuote: Events with the same ID (e.g., messageId, toolCallId) belong to the same logical stream

rules.title: TOOL_CALL_ARGS without start
rules.messageTemplate: TOOL_CALL_ARGS for toolCallId '{toolCallId}' with no open TOOL_CALL_START
rules.specQuote: When an agent needs to use a tool, it emits a ToolCallStart event, followed by one or more ToolCallArgs events that stream the arguments being passed to the tool, and concludes with a ToolCallEnd event.

rules.title: TOOL_CALL_END without start
rules.messageTemplate: TOOL_CALL_END for toolCallId '{toolCallId}' with no open TOOL_CALL_START
rules.specQuote: toolCallId: Matches the ID from ToolCallStart

rules.title: Unterminated tool call
rules.messageTemplate: TOOL_CALL_START id '{toolCallId}' never terminated
rules.specQuote: When an agent needs to use a tool, it emits a ToolCallStart event, followed by one or more ToolCallArgs events that stream the arguments being passed to the tool, and concludes with a ToolCallEnd event.

rules.title: Tool call arguments are not valid JSON
rules.messageTemplate: Concatenated TOOL_CALL_ARGS for toolCallId '{toolCallId}' do not parse as JSON: {error}
rules.specQuote: Frontends should concatenate these deltas in the order received to construct the complete arguments object.

rules.title: Duplicate toolCallId within a run
rules.messageTemplate: toolCallId '{toolCallId}' was already used by a completed tool call
rules.specQuote: toolCallId: Unique identifier for the tool call

rules.title: TOOL_CALL_RESULT before TOOL_CALL_END
rules.messageTemplate: TOOL_CALL_RESULT for toolCallId '{toolCallId}' arrived while the call is still open
rules.specQuote: This event is sent after the tool has been executed by the system and contains the actual output generated by the tool.

rules.title: TOOL_CALL_RESULT references unknown toolCallId
rules.messageTemplate: TOOL_CALL_RESULT references toolCallId '{toolCallId}', which was never started
rules.specQuote: toolCallId: Matches the ID from the corresponding ToolCallStart event

rules.title: parentMessageId references unknown message
rules.messageTemplate: TOOL_CALL_START parentMessageId '{parentMessageId}' matches no message observed in this stream
rules.specQuote: The optional parentMessageId allows linking the tool call to a specific message in the conversation, providing context for why the tool is being used.

rules.title: STATE_DELTA before any STATE_SNAPSHOT
rules.messageTemplate: STATE_DELTA precedes any STATE_SNAPSHOT; the base it applies to is not observable on this stream
rules.specQuote: This event is typically sent at the beginning of an interaction or when synchronization is needed.

rules.title: STATE_DELTA failed to apply
rules.messageTemplate: STATE_DELTA failed to apply: {error}
rules.specQuote: Each delta represents specific changes to apply to the current state model.

rules.title: STATE_DELTA is not a valid RFC 6902 patch document
rules.messageTemplate: STATE_DELTA is not a valid RFC 6902 patch document: {error}
rules.specQuote: The StateDelta event contains incremental updates to the agent's state in the form of JSON Patch operations (as defined in RFC 6902).

rules.title: Mid-run STATE_SNAPSHOT discards accumulated deltas
rules.messageTemplate: STATE_SNAPSHOT replaces state previously built from {deltaCount} delta(s)
rules.specQuote: This event is typically sent at the beginning of an interaction or when synchronization is needed.

rules.title: Shared state declared but never established
rules.messageTemplate: features include 'shared-state' but no STATE_SNAPSHOT was emitted
rules.specQuote: These events are used to manage and synchronize the agent's state with the frontend.

rules.title: REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT without start
rules.messageTemplate: REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT for messageId '{messageId}' with no open REASONING_MESSAGE_START
rules.specQuote: Multiple content events with the same messageId should be concatenated to form the complete visible reasoning.

rules.title: Reasoning unterminated at run end
rules.messageTemplate: {startType} messageId '{messageId}' never ended
rules.specQuote: Reasoning events support LLM reasoning visibility and continuity, enabling chain-of-thought reasoning while maintaining privacy.

rules.title: Malformed SSE framing
rules.messageTemplate: Malformed SSE framing: {detail}

rules.title: Event payload is not valid JSON
rules.messageTemplate: Event payload is not valid JSON: {error}
rules.specQuote: All events share a common set of base properties.

rules.title: Unknown event type
rules.messageTemplate: Unknown event type '{type}' (not in @ag-ui/core v{sdkVersion}, and not RAW or CUSTOM)
rules.specQuote: Events in the protocol are categorized by their purpose.

rules.title: Event fails schema validation for its declared type
rules.messageTemplate: {type}: {detail}
rules.specQuote: All events share a common set of base properties.

rules.title: Unexpected Content-Type
rules.messageTemplate: Content-Type '{contentType}' is neither text/event-stream nor application/x-ndjson

rules.title: No keepalive frame within the configured window
rules.messageTemplate: No event or keepalive frame for {seconds}s

rules.title: Response appears buffered rather than incrementally flushed
rules.messageTemplate: Response appears buffered: {detail}

rules.title: Stream ended without a terminal event
rules.messageTemplate: Connection ended mid-run '{runId}' without RUN_FINISHED or RUN_ERROR
rules.specQuote: Every run terminates with either RunFinished or RunError.

rules.title: RAW event wraps a typed AG-UI event
rules.messageTemplate: RAW event wraps an event of type '{wrappedType}', which has a typed AG-UI equivalent
rules.specQuote: The Raw event acts as a container for events originating from external systems or sources that don't natively follow the Agent UI Protocol.

rules.title: Events carry no timestamps
rules.messageTemplate: None of the {eventCount} events carry the optional timestamp property
rules.specQuote: timestamp: Optional timestamp indicating when the event was created

rules.title: CUSTOM event name is not namespaced
rules.messageTemplate: CUSTOM event name '{name}' has no namespace prefix (e.g. 'vendor.event')
rules.specQuote: Teams should document their custom events to ensure consistent implementation across frontends and agents.
